dialog.title: Request a service
dialog.intro: Tell us what else you need. You get a quote first; nothing is charged before that.
dialog.ownerHint: You cannot request or withdraw anything in the portal view.
dialog.readOnlyHint: You can read your company's requests but not send a new one. Ask the person who looks after the project on your side.

picker.heading: What do you need?
picker.customDescription: Describe what you need in your own words. We get back to you with a quote.
picker.emptyCatalog: Our services will be listed here soon. Until then, simply describe what you need.

form.unavailable: We no longer offer this service at the moment. Choose another one or describe what you need.

project.label: For which project?
project.newProject: This becomes a project of its own. We get back to you with a quote.
project.required: Choose what you need the service for.

hours.label: How many hours?
hours.hint: The hours are available to you as soon as we have confirmed your request.
hours.required: Enter how many hours you need.
hours.range: You can request {min} to {max} whole hours.

title.label: What is it about?
title.placeholder: e.g. A second landing page for our summer offer
title.required: Say briefly what it is about.

description.label: Briefly describe what you need
description.hint: Goal, scope and preferred date help us with the quote.

note.label: Note
note.hint: Optional: anything we should know for the quote.

form.retryNotice: The response did not arrive. Your details are kept for this attempt. Send again to confirm the same request.
form.nonBinding: No commitment – you get a quote first.

sent.title: We have your request.
sent.description: We will look at it and get back to you with a quote. You can follow its status under “My requests”.

list.empty: You have not requested anything yet. Once you send a request, you will see its status here.
list.capped: You are seeing all open requests and your last {count} closed requests.

confirm.title: Withdraw this request?
confirm.description: We will stop working on “{title}”. You can request the service again at any time.

errors.not_found: This service is no longer available. Reload the page and choose another one.
errors.validation: We could not accept this as it is. Please check your details.
errors.limit_reached: You already have many open requests. Once we have answered some, you can send new ones.
errors.duplicate_open: You have already requested a further feedback round for this project. We will get back to you.
errors.locked: We are already working on this request. Message us in the chat if something has changed.
errors.internal: That did not work just now. Please try again.
